decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The roof area of the rear extension shall not be altered or adapted for use as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the provisions of Article 3 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification) no windows or other openings (other than those expressly authorised by this permission) shall be formed in the walls or roof of the extension permitted.

Condition : 5 - The window of the extension facing towards No.506 Staines Road shall be fixed i.e. non-openable, and shall only be provided in obscure glass, details of which shall be submitted to and shall be approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the development is commenced.  This window shall be provided in accordance with the details as approved and shall be retained thereafter as provided. In addition, the window which is to be provided in the flank wall of the original house enabling a habitable room to be created (bedroom indicated on submitted drawing), shall also only be provided in obscure glass, following the detailed approval of the obscure glass by the Local Planning Authority.  This window shall also be provided as fixed, i.e. non-openable, to a point 1.8 metres above floor level, and shall be retained only as provided.

Condition : 6 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions the proposed erection of a single storey rear extension, by reason of positioning, size, scale, design and appearance, is considered to be acceptable having due regard for the existing building, the site characteristics, the immediate local area and the Bedfont Green Conservation Area.  The proposal would not be harmful to the character and appearance of the house, the building of which it forms part or the local area in general, or the defining characteristics of the Bedford Green Conservation Area; neither would it have any undue effect on or be harmful to the amenities of any neighbouring properties.  The development is considered to be in accordance with the spirit of the relevant provisions of adopted UDP policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines), ENV-H.6.4 (Alterations and Extensions), and ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) of the London Borough of Hounslow adopted Unitary Development Plan (2003), and the spirit of the Supplementary Planning Guidance (Residential Extension Guidelines).
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension.
